description: This file defines a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a utility function `createProgressiveExpandController` for managing batch processing tasks that yield control back to the main thread, primarily used for UI responsiveness during large or long-running operations. It facilitates progressive work execution with optional React state management for progress indication.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages batch processing in chunks, yielding to the main thread using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback. Supports start and cancel operations, and provides progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to manage UI state (running, progress, counts) during progressive batch processing, with start and cancel capabilities.
